style.desc: landscape tablet app in iPadOS style; split view with a rounded sidebar column, large touch targets, SF-like system type, grouped inset lists, translucent bars, generous spacing for fingers

arrange.text: The search field sits at the upper right of the list area; each row has a checkbox before the sender and message actions at the far right.
arrange.traits: skin: search and row control placement

description: Read, sort, reply to, forward and compose mail in a web mail client. A web mail client (folders, search, inbox list with row checkboxes, message view, compose)
sample: Just double-checking the setup here. Put the mail from Andre away by archiving it.
identity: A web mail client with folders, a search field, an email list with row checkboxes, a message view, and a composer.
screen: The target message is open, with its row scrolled into the list; it is still in the Inbox.
never: An Undo toast for archiving the target

blocking: The required top content band occupying roughly 25–35% of the content region is missing; the inbox list starts directly beneath its narrow toolbar.
review.correction: Add a coherent summary or mail toolbar band across the top 25–35% of the content region, placing the inbox list and open message below it while preserving the sidebar and bottom navigation.

minor: The top content band is shallower than the suggested 25–35%, but within the allowed sizing tolerance.
